summary.text: Eerie fire dragon pythons are rarely seen mutated beasts. Fang Yuan first fights a mutated beast king in Imperial Court blessed land, then later raises them as a resource.

claims.text: In Imperial Court blessed land, a bright red giant python at least a hundred meters long and as thick as a tower provokes Fang Yuan in a small valley. It has a sharp horn on its head, blood eyes, a creepy purple tongue, and eerie blue flames on that tongue. Fang Yuan names it a rarely seen eerie fire dragon python.

It opens its mouth and shoots a carriage-sized blue purple flame. From a few hundred steps away the heat dries Fang Yuan’s hair and eyebrows. He later kills it while testing an improved killer move. The text calls the eerie fire dragon python a mutated beast king: mutated beasts have rank four battle strength, and their king has strength equivalent to a rank five Gu Master.

Its body carries many fire path wild Gu worms. Loot includes python blood useful for feeding blood path Gu worms, and the eerie fire snake gall, which is valuable enough to sell in treasure yellow heaven. They live in caves as a family. Fang Yuan finds six eggs about a hundred meters underground. Hatching needs daily bathing in eerie fire and python blood, and after hatching the young need teaching from an eerie fire dragon python on how to hunt.

It is a bright red giant python at least a hundred meters long and as thick as a tower, with a sharp horn on its head, a pair of blood eyes, a creepy purple tongue, and eerie blue flames on the tongue.

Fang Yuan later builds charcoal lake in his immortal aperture as the second-best breeding ground for eerie fire dragon pythons. The optimal method is the arrangement used in Dong Fang tribe’s Jade Pool blessed land, but the early cost is too high for him, so he uses charcoal stones to construct the nest, places the pythons inside, and lets them develop.

While cataloging his sovereign immortal aperture, Fang Yuan lists the eerie fire dragon python dens as the first of Mini Western Desert’s three main resource points, with a lot of them gathered in one area.
